sloka: प्रहृष्टा विस्मिताः च अपि ते वीक्षन्ते समंततः ।त्रिविक्रम कृत उत्साहम् नारायणम् इव प्रजाः ॥४-६७-३॥
transliteration: prahṛṣṭā vismitāḥ ca api te vīkṣante samaṁtataḥ ।trivikrama kṛta utsāham nārāyaṇam iva prajāḥ ॥4-67-3॥

translations.english: The monkeys collected together happily, gazing at Hanuman.They were wonderstruck to see Hanuman in that huge form, just as all beings were when they saw Lord Narayana in his incarnation of Vamana.
